title: application-charts v1.0.0 blueprint on the shelf: 15 contributions, Playwright probe pack with three anchored checks, sample-app fixture with negative-run switches
summary: T-2 of the ratified visual round (spec 2026-09-04, section 5.2): the application-charts v1.0.0 blueprint on the shelf. Ships 15 contributions (four REQs on the chart form set, non-colour distinction, text-alternative table and keyboard traversal; six USs binding runtime-observable ACs; two TACs on the render shell and the keyboard traversal contract; three ADRs on chart engine choice, accessible palette and reduced-motion respect), a Playwright probe pack under blueprints/application-charts/probe-packs/application-charts.pack.mjs whose three checks (AC-18102-1 non-colour distinction, AC-18103-1 text-alternative table with cell-per-value contract, AC-18104-1 keyboard traversal with announced-string format and reduced-motion suppression) are anchored to blueprint AC ids per T-0 AC-1701-3 and each carries a description field per spec section 9, and a dependency-free sample-app fixture at packages/rcf-lite/test/fixtures/probe-pack-application-charts/ the pack probes for real. Applies cleanly (validate 0, coverage strict 0, eval strict 0 on a scratch project). Consumes T-0's runner extension; the leaf blueprint the T-3 application-dashboard build consumes.
